label: Customise an ability
hover: Applies the renames, flavor text and bonuses a player picked for their own abilities on the character sheet.
note: Internal: rebuilt on every refresh from the character's abilityCustomisations. Its data sits in _tmp_customisations, so the modifier saves nothing itself. 0 records.

label: Improve an ability
hover: When you use a matching ability, you can choose to improve it, for example with more range, a bigger area or an extra target. Some improvements cost a resource.
sentence: Your {keywords} abilities where {abilityFilter} can gain {params} for {resourceCostAmount} {resourceCostType}
note: Saves name, rules, keywords, abilityFilter, resourceCostType, resourceCostAmount, params (range / radius / target_count); 12 records.

label: Alternate appearance
hover: Gives your token a second look it can switch to, such as a hybrid or beast form. It can start from a bestiary creature's art.
sentence: You can take on your {appearance} appearance, which looks like {monsterDefault}
note: Saves appearance, monsterDefault (bestiary id or none); 13 records.

label: Armor Class formula
hover: Gives you another way to work out your Armor Class; the highest result is used.
sentence: You can calculate your Armor Class as {calculation}
note: Saves calculation; 0 records. 5e leftover: Draw Steel has no Armor Class, and MCDMRules deregisters this type.

label: Attack characteristic
hover: Lets you use a different characteristic for weapon attacks.
sentence: You can attack with {attribute} when using weapons where {weaponFilterCondition}
note: Saves attribute, weaponFilterCondition; 0 records. 5e leftover (an alternative to Strength for attacks); deregistered by MCDMRules.

label: Beastheart companion
hover: Names the creature that is your beastheart's companion.
note: Saves companionType (bestiary id); 0 records. The Beastheart Companion choice (DSCompanionChoice FillChoice) creates it, and that choice is the block authors use.

label: Have a condition
hover: You have this condition while the effect lasts, unless you are immune to it.
note: Saves conditionid, explanation (optional reason shown with the condition); 64 records.

label: Cast through me
hover: Creatures you allow can measure an ability's range from your square instead of their own, for example a summoner casting through a summon.
sentence: Creatures where {filterCondition} can use {keywordFilter} abilities where {abilityFilter} from your square
note: Saves filterCondition (checked against the caster; blank means nobody can use it), abilityFilter, keywordFilter; 4 records.

label: Custom spellcasting
hover: Lets you cast spells from a spell list by paying a resource instead of using spell slots.
sentence: You can cast {spellList} spells up to level {maxLevel} for {costFormula} {resourceType}
note: Saves resourceType, spellList, maxLevel, costFormula, methodid; 0 records. 5e spellcasting leftover; deregistered by MCDMRules.

label: Damage after a save
hover: Changes how much damage you take after you succeed or fail on a saving throw.
sentence: After a {attrid} save, you take {onsuccess} damage on a success and {onfail} on a failure
note: Saves attrid, affect, onsuccess, onfail; 0 records. 5e saving throw leftover; deregistered by MCDMRules.

label: Hit every marked target
hover: When you aim a single-target ability at a creature that carries your named effect, and enough creatures carry it, the ability targets all of them instead. Range and line of effect don't matter for the extra targets.
sentence: Your single-target abilities hit every creature with your {effectName} when {minCount} or more have it
note: Saves effectName, minCount (default 3); 1 record (Revenger's Wrap).

label: Can't target unless
hover: Limits which creatures you can make opportunity attacks against or have line of effect to, using a rule about the target.
note: Saves filterid (opportunityattack or lineofeffect), filter; 5 records.

label: Swap forced movement
hover: When you force move a creature, you can use a different kind of forced movement, such as a vertical push instead of a push.
sentence: When you {movementTypes.from} a creature, you can {movementTypes.to} it instead
note: Saves movementTypes (list of from/to pairs); 5 records. The records use to: vertical_push, which the current editor's dropdown does not offer.

label: Creature keyword
hover: Gives you an extra creature keyword, such as an ancestry keyword for a rival, so rules that check keywords count it.
note: Saves keyword; 13 records. Only monster:Keywords reads it, so it does nothing on heroes.

label: Grant a spell list
hover: Adds a spell list to one of your spellcasting features.
sentence: Your {applyto} spellcasting can use the {listid} spell list
note: Saves listid, applyto; 0 records. 5e spellcasting leftover; deregistered by MCDMRules.

label: Grant spells
hover: Adds specific spells to one of your spellcasting features.
note: Saves spells, applyto; 0 records. 5e spellcasting leftover; deregistered by MCDMRules.

label: Choose a treasure
hover: You pick one treasure that matches a category, echelon and keywords. You then claim it into your inventory, or it appears when an ability calls for it.
sentence: You gain a {treasureEchelon} {treasureCategory} with {treasureKeywords} of your choice, {treasureDelivery}
note: Saves treasureCategory, treasureEchelon, treasureKeywords, treasureNote, treasureDelivery (claim or manifest), treasureId; 7 records.

label: Ignore difficult terrain
hover: You move through difficult terrain as if it were normal ground. This can cover all difficult terrain or only terrain with certain keywords, such as Magic or Psionic.
note: Saves keywords (empty means all difficult terrain); 1 record (Human: Magic and Psionic).

label: Innate spell
hover: Lets you cast a particular spell without using spell slots.
sentence: You can cast {spell} at level {level} using {attribute}
note: Saves spell, attribute, level, usageLimitOptions; 0 records. 5e spellcasting leftover; deregistered by MCDMRules.

label: Invisible
hover: You are invisible, so you always have concealment from other creatures unless you are immune to concealment.
note: No fields; 0 records in the data YAML (it appears only in a docs file).

label: Journal note
hover: Adds a heading and text to a journal entry. They appear when an ability shows that entry, for example to explain what a feature does.
note: Saves heading, explanationText, targetDocId; 4 records. The Show Journal Entry ability behavior reads it.

label: Light source
hover: Gives you a special light, such as a glow, that you can choose as your token's light.
note: Saves itemid (a restricted light-source gear item); 3 records.

label: Loyalty collar
hover: You wear an explosive loyalty collar. Your token shows it as a frame with a blinking light, and it blows up when its trigger fires.
note: No fields; 41 records (war dogs). The explosion comes from the trait's triggered ability.

label: Give your companion
hover: Your beastheart companion gains the effects you put inside this block.
note: Saves feature (nested modifiers); 33 records.

label: Creature type
hover: Adds to or replaces your creature type, such as undead.
note: Saves monsterType, addType; 0 records. 5e-style creature type; Draw Steel uses keywords instead (the Creature keyword block).

label: Change damage rolls
hover: Adds dice, bonuses or edges to your damage rolls when a condition is met.
note: Saves modifyRoll, damageFilterCondition, subtype, crit, customTrigger. 3 old records still use it (edge and boon effects). Deregistered by MCDMRules; Draw Steel uses power roll modifiers instead.

label: Give your rider
hover: A creature riding you gains the effects you put inside this block.
note: Saves feature (nested modifiers); 5 records.

label: Heroic resource checklist
hover: Adds reminders to your heroic resource checklist saying when you gain your heroic resource and how much.
note: Saves resourceChecklist (entries of name, details, quantity, mode: once per combat / once per round / recurring); 5 records.

label: Give your squad captain
hover: The captain of your minion squad gains the effects you put inside this block.
note: Saves feature (nested modifiers); 1 record (War Dog Tetherite).

label: Give your summoner or summons
hover: Passes the effects inside this block from a summoned creature to its summoner, or from a summoner to its summons.
note: Saves mode (summoner or summons), feature (nested modifiers); 71 records.

label: Change a triggered action
hover: When a matching triggered action comes up, it gets extra options, such as a new mode, a different cost or a different action.
sentence: When a triggered action where {triggerCondition} comes up, it gains {attributes}
note: Saves triggerCondition, attributes (add mode / modify cost / modify action), interceptStrikes, replaceBehaviors, ability; 19 records.

label: Monster modes
hover: Gives the monster named modes the Director can switch between, such as before and after its true name is spoken. Other effects can depend on the current mode.
note: Saves modes (list of name and description; needs 2 or more); 11 records. Other modifiers check Monster Mode.

label: Carried along
hover: The creature that put this effect on you carries you with it when it moves, as if you were grabbed.
note: Saves carrier (condition_caster), useGrabMovementPenalty, countsTowardGrabLimit; 5 records.

label: Can't approach or stray
hover: Stops you moving closer to a creature, as when frightened, or stops you moving too far from it, as when hooked.
note: Saves targetFormula, restrictionType (approach, or leash, which uses distance), distance; 3 records.

label: Multiple attacks
hover: Placeholder for making more than one attack.
sentence: You can attack more than once
note: No fields, no hooks and an empty editor; 0 records. 5e leftover; deregistered by MCDMRules.

label: Power roll trigger
hover: Lets you react to a power roll, for example when you take damage, by changing the roll or its result.
sentence: When {trigger}, you can change the power roll by {powerRollModifier}
note: Saves type, targetType, trigger, range, rules, powerRollModifier; 154 records. Replaced by the new triggered ability editor.

label: Add to a power roll trigger
hover: Adds an extra option, usually for an extra cost, to another power roll trigger you have.
note: Saves original (trigger name), additionalModifier; 2 records. It only extends power roll triggers, which the new triggered ability editor replaces, so that editor should cover it.

label: Reciprocal condition
hover: When a nearby creature gives you a condition, that creature gets a condition back, for example it is weakened while it has you grabbed.
sentence: While a creature within {maxRange} squares has you {sourceConditionid}, it is {conditionid}
note: Saves sourceConditionid, conditionid, maxRange (0 means any distance); 1 record (Nettlebloom).

label: Rolls against me
hover: Changes attack or damage rolls that other creatures make against you.
note: Saves rollType, modifyRoll, filterRoll; 0 records. 5e leftover; deregistered by MCDMRules.

label: Routine
hover: Gives you a routine you can choose to keep going each round, shown with its distance, target and effect.
note: Saves ability (name, type, distance, target, flavor, effect, keywords); 13 records.

label: Spellcasting
hover: Gives you a spellcasting feature with spell slots and a spell list.
sentence: You cast spells as a {classid} with {leveling} progression
note: Saves classid, leveling, customLevelingFormula, spellcasting; 0 records. 5e leftover; deregistered by MCDMRules.

label: Status icon
hover: Shows an icon on your token and status bar while the effect lasts.
note: Saves statusIcon, iconColor; 13 records.

label: Can't use (ability)
hover: Stops you using certain abilities, chosen by name or keyword. With an explanation they show greyed out with the reason; without one they are hidden.
sentence: You can't use {name} or {keywords} abilities because {explanation}
note: Saves name, keywords, abilityFilter (true keeps the ability usable), explanation; 57 records.

label: Suspended in air
hover: Holds you off the ground at a set height, as when you are caught in a snare or net, or levitating.
sentence: You are held {altitude} squares off the ground
note: Saves altitude; 7 records. It sets _tmp_suspended, which only the engine reads, so its exact effect can't be seen in the Lua.

label: Token effect
hover: Plays a looping visual on your token while the effect lasts, such as flames when you are burning.
note: Saves visualEffect (default onfire); 1 record (Burning).

label: Transformation
hover: While you are transformed into a creature, you use its stats. You can also take its abilities, immunities, skills, movement, size and look.
sentence: While transformed, you use the creature's {attributes}
note: Saves attributes, inheritAbilities, inheritResistances, inheritSkills, overrideMovement, gainCreatureVisuals, transformSize, banspells, banequipment; 23 records, all with source Transformation and deletable false. The spell and equipment bans are 5e-style.

label: Triggered ability display
hover: Shows a triggered ability card on your sheet for reference.
note: Saves ability (a display-only card); 354 records. Replaced by the new triggered ability editor.
